question:
Identify the error in the sentence.

This route is most safer than the highway.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"most"** is used to denote the highest degree of comparison among three or more items. It is commonly used with adjectives to form the superlative degree. (अधिकतम)

 
 
• **Example:** She is the most talented student in her class.
 
 
 
• However, in the given sentence, the word "safer" is already in the comparative form. Using "most" alongside "safer" creates a grammatical error because "safer" does not require a superlative marker. The correct form would simply be "safer." (सुरक्षित)
 
 
• **Example:** This route is safer than the highway.
 
 
 
• Hence, the word "most" is the incorrect usage in this sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1 - Safer** (सुरक्षित): A comparative form of the adjective "safe," used to compare two items in terms of their safety.

 
 
• **Example:** Wearing a helmet is safer than riding without one.
 
 
 
• **Option 2 - Highway** (राजमार्ग): A main road, especially one connecting major towns or cities.
 
 
• **Example:** The highway was closed due to heavy snowfall.
 
 
 
• **Option 4 - Route** (मार्ग): A way or course taken to get from one place to another.
 
 
• **Example:** We took the scenic route to enjoy the beautiful views.
